note: Evidence-based BLE/WiFi signatures for camera smart glasses. Verified items are sourced; unverified marked. Research files in /home/leozhang/lenswatch-research (local) and summaries cited below.
sources: ACAB detection project signature tables + 2026-07-31 field capture

signatures.label: Ray-Ban Meta, confirmed
signatures.notes: ACAB field capture 2026-07-31 (70 min, 1568 rows) of worn Ray-Ban/Oakley Meta glasses. Matches token in both byte orders as confidence bump.

signatures.label: Ray-Ban Meta frames (Luxottica)
signatures.notes: Luxottica Group is eyewear-only registrant. Appeared zero times in the one capture; advertise-while-worn needs confirmation.

signatures.label: HeyCyan-class glasses (Anko/Kogan/Nilox/Temu)
signatures.notes: In vendor SDK and 3 independent projects. CRITICAL: match the full 16 bytes only; the 96-bit base is shared with Apple ANCS and a prefix match fires on every notification wearable. Also match in both byte orders if raw AD is available.

signatures.label: Snap Spectacles
signatures.notes: Snap's only BLE hardware is Spectacles.

signatures.label: Vuzix camera AR glasses
signatures.notes: Eyewear-only AR maker; Blade/M400/Shield/Z100 all have cameras.

signatures.label: Meta member service UUID
signatures.notes: Bluetooth SIG member_uuids.yaml, registrant Meta Platforms. Gate with Quest caveat.

signatures.label: Meta member service UUID
signatures.notes: Bluetooth SIG member_uuids.yaml, registrant Meta Platforms.

signatures.label: Meta corporate company ID (possible glasses)
signatures.notes: One capture confirmed it on worn glasses, but it is a corporate ID shared across Meta devices.

signatures.label: Meta Technologies company ID (gate it)
signatures.notes: Shared with Meta Quest; only meaningful combined with META_RB_GLASS token. Never match bare.

signatures.label: Jieli audio SoC (possible cheap glasses)
signatures.notes: Bluetooth AUDIO SoC vendor; matches a huge population of cheap earbuds and speakers. Must show as possible only (e.g. Rogbird VisionPro, Rollme VistaView).

signatures.label: TCL / RayNeo glasses
signatures.notes: TCL phones/tablets/TVs also use it. Gate it.

signatures.label: Device name patterns
signatures.notes: Strong during pairing only; Meta glasses rarely advertise names in the field. 'Meta' alone can collide with other Meta gadgets.

signatures.label: Meta Ray-Ban Display (Even G2)
signatures.notes: Community-reconstructed from OpenGlasses transport code. Needs field capture.

ouiNotes: OUI/MAC-prefix matching is USELESS for Meta glasses (resolvable private addresses rotate). For cheap glasses it is medium-strength at best (chipset OUIs shared with earbuds). The popular community 'Meta OUI' list (7C:2A:9E, CC:66:0A, F4:03:43, 5C:E9:1E) is WRONG: CC:66:0A and 5C:E9:1E are Apple, F4:03:43 is HPE. Verified relevant OUIs: 98:59:49 Luxottica; Meta Platforms: 48:05:60, 50:99:03, 78:C4:FA, 80:F3:EF, 84:57:F7, 88:25:08, 94:F9:29, B4:17:A8, C0:DD:8A, CC:A1:74, D0:B3:C2, D4:D6:59 (Quest-shared); F4:4E:FD Actions Semiconductor (cheap camera glasses chip); C8:47:8C, 70:87:9E Beken; 00:E0:4C, FC:93:4E Realtek; D4:8A:FC, E4:65:B8 Espressif; C4:19:D1, 38:22:28 Telink; C8:58:6A, 28:6D:CD Beijing Winner Micro.
wifiNotes: HeyCyan-class glasses use WiFi hotspot for media transfer (BLE sends SSID+password at runtime; gateway probed at 192.168.43.1 / 192.168.4.1 / 192.168.1.1 / 192.168.0.1 / 10.0.0.1; manifest at http://IP/manifest.json; default password fallback 123456789). No fixed Anko_xxxx SSID documented. A PHONE cannot sniff probe requests (platform limit) - only the ESP32 accessory in monitor mode can. Phone can only see beaconing APs.
gaps: Exact BLE advertising name of Kmart Anko, Kogan, Dick Smith, Woolworths, Temu camera glasses. ZERO public documentation. Hypothesis from decompiled SDK: names start with O_ or Q_ or contain cyan, unverified.
Do HeyCyan-class devices advertise the 7905FFF0 service UUID persistently while worn? Never observed in captures yet.
META_RB_GLASS token byte framing on the wire (only both-byte-order matching so far).
Advertise-while-worn confirmation for Luxottica 0x0D53, Meta corp 0x01AB, Meta Tech 0x058E.
Meta Ray-Ban Stories (pre-Meta-AI generation) BLE behavior is undocumented.
